description: This Swift file defines a class `MenuContextCardInjector` responsible for injecting a custom context menu card into a macOS status bar menu. The class manages cache loading, menu item insertion, and UI updates for session data displayed in the menu, utilizing SwiftUI views embedded in AppKit components.

classes.name: MenuContextCardInjector
classes.description: A singleton class that manages injecting and updating a custom context menu card into a macOS status menu, handling cache refreshes, menu item insertion, and UI updates.

methods.name: install(into:)
methods.description: Sets up the injector into a status item, replacing the menu delegate to inject custom UI elements.

methods.name: menuWillOpen(_ menu:)
methods.description: Handles the menu opening event, inserting a custom card view and triggering cache refresh Asynchronously.

methods.name: menuDidClose(_ menu:)
methods.description: Cleans up when the menu closes, cancelling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate(_ menu:)
methods.description: Allows updating the menu if needed, delegating to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect(for: on:)
methods.description: Determines the rect bounds within which the menu can appear.

methods.name: refreshCache(force:)
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the cache of session rows, handling errors and updating stored data.

methods.name: cachedView()
methods.description: Returns a SwiftUI view representing the current cached session data.

methods.name: loadCurrentRows()
methods.description: Loads and filters current session rows based on activity time window.

methods.name: findInsertIndex(in:)
methods.description: Finds the appropriate index to insert the custom card view in the menu.

methods.name: initialCardWidth(for:)
methods.description: Determines initial width for the card based on previous menu widths and defaults.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable(for:hosting:)
methods.description: Captures the width of the menu for consistent sizing across openings.
